subject: general
question:
There is a spelling error in the given sentence. Select the option that contains the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

The precious bookshelf was carefully decorated with religiuos books.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "religiuos".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"religiuos"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "religious". (धार्मिक)
 
 
• **Example:** He is deeply religious and attends church every Sunday.
 
 
 
• **"Precious"** means something of great value; not to be wasted or treated carelessly. (बहुमूल्य)
 
 
• **Example:** The precious gem was locked away in a secure vault.
 
 
 
• **"Carefully"** refers to doing something with caution and attention to detail. (सावधानीपूर्वक)
 
 
• **Example:** She carefully wrapped the gift in beautiful paper.
 
 
 
• **"Decorated"** means to make something look more attractive by adding items or images. (सजाया हुआ)
 
 
• **Example:** The room was decorated with balloons and streamers for the party.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "religiuos".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Precious** (बहुमूल्य): Something of great value; not to be wasted or treated carelessly.
 
 
• **Example:** The precious gem was locked away in a secure vault.
 
 
 
• **Carefully** (सावधानीपूर्वक): Doing something with caution and attention to detail.
 
 
• **Example:** She carefully wrapped the gift in beautiful paper.
 
 
 
• **Decorated** (सजाया हुआ): To make something look more attractive by adding items or images.
 
 
• **Example:** The room was decorated with balloons and streamers for the party.
